lab_overrides: Current host executables and units overlaid in RAM on the earlier immutable laboratory host.
Public gateway account entries and public QEMU root/mount target supplied in RAM; new host build contains both.
Gateway kernel, initrd and readonly squashfs copied into RAM and checked against exact byte sizes and SHA256 digests.
Host gateway unit uses the lab-emulation executable, laboratory config and volatile journal stderr; production stdout/stderr remain null.
Controller stop composition uses the real controller unit with only lab executable/config and manager Wants removed; the 19-check regression separately runs the real manager.

failed_attempts.cause_and_resolution: Virtio block serial was truncated; shortened the lab disk serial to oblivion-gw-image.
The old immutable host image lacked UID 1101; new host build defines the account, fixture supplies equivalent public account entries in RAM.
Same missing UID 1101, with additional volatile service diagnostics.
QEMU copied under noexec /run could not execute; fixture now uses a separate readonly executable tmpfs containing only public QEMU files.
The minimal QEMU root lacked the optional PXE ROM; production gateway NICs now explicitly disable the unused boot ROM.
Gateway Before ordering formed a stop-job cycle with owner ExecStopPost; removed gateway ordering while retaining BindsTo and the session shutdown ordering.

checks.native_clippy: passed --all-targets --features lab-emulation -- -D warnings; Linux code compiled by the Debian build and exercised in the VM
checks.repository_check: lint and 34 typecheck tasks passed; all 34 typecheck tasks were cache hits

limits: Process exit and missing sockets establish VM termination in these tests, not physical erasure of all host RAM copies.
Fixed synthetic marker scans cover the inspected runtime files and final raw data disk; they are not a complete syscall trace or proof that all sensitive data is absent.
Host gateway configures the supervisor but issues no grant and does not enable Tor. Chat NIC, token delivery and adapter are not connected.
The readonly general-profile test is not full ephemeral session mode.
This is a laboratory overlay, not a bootable final Oblivion live image.
remaining_gates: Session NIC, one-session token delivery, grant/revoke and A-to-B lifecycle integration
Persistent Tor state, network enablement, real provider compatibility and tool proxy
Global shutdown, power loss, OOM, blocked I/O, physical KVM/hardware and independent privileged-boundary review
